name: cliff-walk-up
description: Item 5 (user 2026-11-06: also in farming paths, and down / up cliffs in meadows): a farming troll that walks to a far place (TrollFarmer.StartTravel, the same walk as to a tree or the spot) across a 4 - 15 m terrain step climbs up it over the ledge walk instead of giving up. Needs a cliff within 120 m of the arena (stt.findCliff); fails with its position text when the world has none.

steps.name: stt.findCliff
steps.label: a cliff exists in the loaded terrain near the arena

steps.name: stt.cliffTravel
steps.label: the troll starts its walk to the other side of the cliff
within 90 s the troll stands on the other side of the cliff
